changeSet.author: aav
changeSet.comment: Reviewed descriptions for empty fields and exact-pair bibliographic corrections. Runs once; later admin edits remain authoritative.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE catalogue_description_seed(title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, author VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, text VARCHAR(3000) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(title,author)); CREATE TABLE catalogue_metadata_seed(old_title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, old_author VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, new_title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, new_author VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(old_title,old_author));
